answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 9503 Country: India Title: I have put my daughter name "ZUNAIRAH". Is this name is correct according to Islam and what its actual meanings. i also want to add something before her name. Plz suggest what. Question: I have put my daughter name "ZUNAIRAH". Is this name is correct according to Islam and what its actual meanings. i also want to add something before her name. Plz suggest what. Answer ID: 9503 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2520/2073=B/1429) Zunairah means: a woman who fills vessel, a woman wearing zunnar . As per the Shariah, this name is not correct. Change it to some other name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
